Show a quality summary after each stream.
The number of pixels sent by the cloud PC. Higher resolutions look sharper but require more decoder, GPU, and network capacity.
Matches the stream shape to the display. A mismatched ratio can add black bars or stretching; it does not make the decoder faster.
Recommended uses this device\'s display, memory, processor count, Android profile, and verified WebRTC hardware decoders. Custom keeps your manual choices.
Frames per second controls motion smoothness. Higher FPS gives the decoder less time per frame and can cause stutter on slower hardware.
The maximum video data rate. Higher bitrate can improve detail, but only when the connection has enough stable capacity; it does not increase FPS.

H.264 is the most compatible. H.265 uses bandwidth more efficiently and is preferred for high resolution when a verified hardware decoder exists. AV1 is 8-bit here and is used only on devices with a compatible hardware path.
8-bit 4:2:0 is the lightest and most compatible. 10-bit improves gradients but adds decoder and bandwidth requirements. Android normalizes unsupported combinations automatically.
AV1 uses 8-bit color. Choose H.265 for 10-bit; HDR is limited to compatible Android TV modes.
AV1 uses 8-bit color in OpenNOW. Switched to 8-bit and disabled HDR. Choose H.265 or H.264 to use 10-bit.
HDR needs a compatible Android TV display, H.265, 10-bit video, and a supported membership. It adds processing load and is not recommended for lag troubleshooting.
HDR streaming is not available on Android handhelds. 10-bit SDR remains available with H.265.
HDR on Android TV requires H.265 at 60 FPS or lower and a resolution up to 3840 x 2160.
Routes GFN session creation and queue polling through this proxy. Leave off for direct requests.
Codec probe has not run yet.
GFN session creation, queue polling, resume, stop, and queue ad update requests will be routed through the proxy you enter.
A bad or blocked proxy can break launch, queue progress, active session resume, or session cleanup.
Only use a proxy you trust. The proxy operator may be able to observe request timing, destination hosts, and sensitive session traffic metadata.
Requests NVIDIA\'s low-latency, low-loss transport path when the server and network support it. Leave off if your network gets unstable.
Sends your default Android microphone to the streamed game. You can mute it from Stream Controls.

How the on-screen buttons are drawn. Outline and Neon let more of the game through; High contrast stays readable over bright scenes.

On by default. Fills the display instead of leaving black bars, by stretching the picture on the mismatched axis only — never by cropping it. Turn this off for exact geometry.
Applies an extra GPU filter after decoding. It can improve perceived detail but may add rendering load on slower devices.
Controls the strength of the post-processing sharpening filter. It does not change the source stream resolution.
Thanks to the people helping improve OpenNOW for everyone.
Intercepts the hardware decoder to inject low-latency vendor properties. May be unstable.
Requests variable refresh timing when the device, display, plan, and GFN session support it.
Native touch Auto uses gamepad mode for high-resolution or high-FPS streams so the selected stream mode is preserved. Choose Every game to prioritize native touch instead.
Everything here applies as you pick it.
Shimmer, focus glows, and carousel motion. Turning this off also honours the system animation setting.

FPS, ping, and connection health while you play. The fastest way to tell a network problem from a device problem.
Open it from the in-stream controls, or from the report offered after a session ends.
It checks your settings against the session first and flags known-bad combinations, usually with a fix.
It sends your description plus redacted diagnostics — settings, decoder and network measurements, device model. No account details.
Latency, frame pacing, and packet loss when a session ends, with a shortcut into the bug reporter.
Helps find patterns across crashes and performance problems. Sensitive data is removed and nothing is sold. With this off, a crash report may not carry enough to investigate.
